notes.title: Demo is Live
notes.content:
Unleash the chaos

Do you love creating chaos and destruction with your friends? Do you enjoy awesome weapons and skills? Do you crave intense battles in diverse arenas with tons of mayhem?

If you answered yes to any of these questions, then you need to check out the Carnage Demo, the multiplayer top-down shooter game that will blow your mind!

Carnage is a game where you can unleash your creativity and carnage in a variety of ways. You can hunt the other players, you can hide and ambush anyone who happens to pass by, or you can use the defenseless NPC:s for target practice.

You can also pick different abilities when you enter a skirmish, wanna play a bit defensive? Pick healing. Wanna run and gun? Well then Rampage is the ability for you. The game features three different arenas, each with its own challenges and hazards, where you can battle it out against other players in real time multiplayer.

The demo is live and available now, and it includes one of the three finished arenas, as well as a sample of the different skills that you can pick when you enter a skirmish. You can play it for free only here on Steam, join the carnage today!

Don’t miss this opportunity to experience the ultimate top-down shooter game that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Carnage is part of the Games in Sweden Steam Festival, where you can discover more amazing games from Swedish developers. The festival ends on February 5, so hurry up and join the fun!

What are you waiting for? Download Carnage now and let the carnage begin! 🔥
